rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for high temperature and for feeling feverish.

example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6

rows.note: Use this instead of 熱 when the heat is the spicy pungency of food or chilies.

example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 gaa3 lei1 zan1 hai6 hou2 laat6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word for someone who is physically or sexually attractive.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sok3

rows.note: Use this for someone who is habitually short-tempered and easily angered.

example.english: Your boss is always so hot and quick to anger.
example.jyutping: nei5 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 cou3 dai2
